headline: Heat Pumps in Ukiah and Northern California: Rebates, Winter Performance and Solar
subheading: Seb from AC&R Service in Ukiah explains the City of Ukiah and Sonoma Clean Power heat pump rebates, how heat pumps handle a NorCal winter, when to go ductless, and why heat pumps pair well with solar.
seoTitle: Ukiah Heat Pumps: Rebates and NorCal Winter Performance
description: A Ukiah HVAC contractor explains City of Ukiah and Sonoma Clean Power heat pump rebates, NorCal winter performance, ducted vs ductless, and adding solar.
